<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data the most intense ion is at m/z 224.1201. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈ 223.1128 Da. A formula that matches this exact mass is C₁₆H₁₅O (monoisotopic mass 223.1123 Da), which is within typical measurement error. Hence the molecular formula of the sample compound is C16H15O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
